tools.name: search_condos
tools.description: Search condos for rent or sale in Bangkok by budget (THB), bedrooms, BTS/MRT station or line, walking minutes to the station, district and size. Returns the matching listings with their bkkradar.com links and the same search on the map. Show the links to the user.

tools.name: get_listing
tools.description: Details of one listing found by search_condos or nearby_condos: price, size, bedrooms, furnishing, pets, deposit, minimum lease, amenities, station and walk, and a warning when the post asks for money before a viewing. Returns its bkkradar.com link.

tools.name: list_stations
tools.description: Bangkok's BTS, MRT and Airport Link stations with the number of rentals within 1 km and the median monthly rent by bedrooms (studio, 1, 2, 3+), busiest first, optionally for one line. Each station has its bkkradar.com page.

tools.name: area_stats
tools.description: Median rent or sale price and number of listings for one BTS/MRT station (within 1 km), one line, or one district or neighbourhood of Bangkok, overall and by bedrooms. Use it to tell whether a price is fair. Returns the bkkradar.com page.

tools.name: nearby_condos
tools.description: Condos around a point in Bangkok, such as an office, a school, a residence or a station, given as lat/lng or as a place name or address. Same filters as search_condos plus radius_km, sorted by distance or by walk to a station. Returns bkkradar.com links.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_listing · Public sink: get_listing.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_listing · Public sink: get_listing

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
